instruction: The global play/pause hotkey in VLC is interfering with other applications on my system. Could you help me disable the global hotkey so VLC only responds to play/pause when it's the active window?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the global play/pause hotkey in VLC. The evaluator checks the global-key-play-pause setting in VLC config file. Expected value is 0 (disabled - empty value in config). Uses existing check_global_key_play_pause metric function.
metadata.verification: Checked existing VLC metric functions. check_global_key_play_pause reads vlcrc file and checks if global-key-play-pause is empty (returns 0) or set (returns 1). Expected 0 means the global hotkey should be disabled.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) using get_vlc_config
Metric logic correctly checks if global-key-play-pause is disabled (empty value in config returns 0, any value returns 1)
Expected value of 0 semantically matches instruction requirement to disable global hotkey
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement (disable global play/pause hotkey)
Correct parameter handling: metric uses 'rule' parameter and directly accesses rule['expected_global_key_play_pause'], which is correct for type='rule'
Appropriate postconfig: kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes take effect
Proper error handling for missing config file or exceptions
Default value of 0 when config line not found is reasonable (treats absence as disabled)
